body:
Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT reference image 1, the original reaper Hagi stepping sprite, to make her forward-CHARGING pose MUCH more aggressive and forward-leaning. Reference image 2 is supporting identity/costume/weapon reference only. Deliver ONE full-body game sprite, vertical 1024x1536 RGBA, genuine transparent background. Keep the exact same character, face, body proportions, black bob with tiny dusty red braid, black outfit and opaque upper-mid-thigh layered skirt, soft dark gray / muted dusty crimson trailing cloth, gold fittings, one black stocking on anatomical left/front leg, same boots. Same clean silver scythe, one gold-root LARGE OVAL HOLE, three narrow blade marks, no bells, chains, blood or extra ornaments.
CRITICAL CHANGE: Her torso must form a strong diagonal, approximately 30–35 DEGREES ABOVE HORIZONTAL, leaning almost into a sprint. She bends forward AT THE HIPS with back and neck anatomically connected. Move her pelvis BACK toward screen-left and head/shoulders far FORWARD toward screen-right. The head and shoulders visibly lead the charge. Approximate staging: hips around (430,970), shoulders around (710,760), head centered around (820,620); these positions indicate the strong forward displacement, not rigid tracing requirements. The upper body MUST NOT remain nearly vertical like the input. Do not merely spread/bend the knees, and do not simply rotate the whole sprite. Lowered pelvis, front left knee bends and absorbs weight ahead, rear right leg stretches diagonally backward and forcefully pushes off the ground. Both boots visible with natural ball/toe contact, soles around y=1430, grounded low forward burst, not floating or kneeling. Head faces the enemy to screen-right, eyes lifted under a sharp brow with a confident fierce smirk. Hair and soft cloth STREAM BACK TO THE LEFT, pulled straight by speed, no new giant ribbons. A readable, purposeful rushing attack, not a pinup.
Keep her face size and anatomy scale close to the input; let the lowered body occupy less vertical height rather than enlarging it. Keep skirt overlapping and fully covering pelvis, no underwear. Weapon and body pose remain physically coherent: hold the same one continuous STRAIGHT scythe shaft in BOTH hands close in FRONT of the torso, elbows bent and braced, both hands CLOSE firmly around it with opposing thumbs and curled fingers. Carry it slightly lower and swept back during the rush, ready to rise into the windup. Maintain the weapon's scale, whole blade and shaft butt visible; blade clear of face. Never bend the rigid shaft or split it into two, and never leave fingertips resting on the surface without grasping. Preserve the scythe silhouette and single oval socket cutout exactly in design.
Natural fine anime rendering, soft supple hair and matte fabric as references, consistent black / muted crimson / GRAY palette. No purple or white recolor. Full body and complete weapon inside canvas with safe margins. No motion blur, FX, ghost images, background, floor, shadow, text, border, label or watermark. Keep all non-pose identity and costume features unchanged. The result should unmistakably look like she is throwing her weight forward and charging, a substantially stronger lean than reference 1.
rig:
Use case: identity-preserve. Generate one corrected full-body charging sprite of Hagi on truly transparent background. Reference 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE weapon and identity reference: the scythe has a LONG PERFECTLY STRAIGHT rigid pole. Reference 2 is for the strong forward-leaning BODY AND LEGS ONLY. Do NOT copy reference 2's impossible bent pole.
Create the same short black-bob adult reaper in the same original black / muted dusty red / charcoal GRAY soft costume and gold trim. Opaque overlapping thigh-length skirt covers pelvis, same front left black stocking, rear right bare leg, same boots, natural soft hair, same face and confident gaze toward screen-right. Same silver crescent and single large oval gold-root hole, with three narrow blade marks. No new colors or ornament.
POSE is a forceful grounded dash to RIGHT: hips back left, chest and shoulders projected far forward, head leading, back about 30–35 degrees above horizontal, front left knee bends deeply and rear right leg stretches back pushing off. Strong forward weight, hair and trailing soft cloth stream left. Preserve the clear aggressive forward lean from reference 2, not upright stance. Both boots visible, full anatomy coherent. Preserve face and body pixel scale. No jump or kneeling.
REDRAW THE WEAPON AND BOTH ARMS/HANDS FROM SCRATCH. Change the weapon's ORIENTATION and position as much as necessary. The long handle must be ONE SINGLE RULER-STRAIGHT BLACK POLE, from the gold butt, THROUGH BOTH closed hands and ONWARD to the blade's collar. Every segment of the handle is collinear. Carry the pole LOWER AND MORE HORIZONTAL across the front of her hips/abdomen during the rush, NOT upright in front of her face. Both elbows bend naturally and the hands grip the same line, each four fingers curled around with an opposing thumb. The blade assembly itself rotates rigidly to fit at the front end; do not preserve the old upright blade position while bending the shaft to reach it. The gold socket must connect DIRECTLY in the same straight line as both hands and butt. The reference's old curved-looking black pole is WRONG and must be entirely absent. No curved handle, no crooked neck, no cane, no hook handle, no branch or second shaft.
Choose a coherent composition that keeps the ENTIRE large crescent and pole and both boots inside the frame, even if you need a slightly WIDER vertical canvas. Canvas 1280x1536 or 1024x1536 is suitable. Leave safe margins. Keep face and main torso unobscured. No floating hands, no weapon passing through her torso. Natural fine anime linework and matte shading matching reference 1. No blood, bells, dangling chains, FX, ghosts, backdrop, floor shadow, text, labels or borders. Genuine transparent RGBA. This is primarily a weapon-rig correction plus strong charging pose; prioritize the perfectly straight continuous pole and clear forward lean over matching old arm positions.
finish:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Finish this exact strongly forward-leaning Hagi sprite as a clean production PNG. Preserve the exact body pose, face, straight two-handed nearly horizontal scythe shaft, fingers, costume colors and identity. DO NOT change the rigid straight handle or either hand. This weapon rig is now correct.
Make two small corrections:
1. Give the whole sprite a clean transparent safety margin on all sides on a 1280x1536 RGBA canvas. The current right edge cuts the scythe; complete the outermost missing edge/tiny spikes of the blade so no weapon or cloth is cropped. Keep the character/head at approximately the same pixel scale; add canvas space rather than substantially shrinking or enlarging her. Both boots and weapon butt stay fully visible. Avoid changing proportions.
2. There must be EXACTLY ONE LARGE OVAL HOLE in the scythe's gold-decorated head, the gold-rimmed oval nearest the three parallel blade marks. Fill the SECOND SMALLER dark oval opening to its right (currently at the cropped outer edge) with solid matching silver/dark steel and gold edge detail, so it is metal, NOT another hole. Preserve the main oval, three narrow blade marks and overall crescent silhouette. Same clean silver with no blood.
Clean the transparency edges: remove stray red/white speckles and fringing outside the character, hair, cloth and scythe; preserve soft anti-aliasing and naturally wispy hair but no background-colored halos. All spaces outside the sprite and through the ONE oval and between limbs are genuinely transparent. Fully opaque character itself.
Do not change the forceful charging lean: hips back, head/shoulders far forward, torso tilted down toward screen-right, rear leg pushing, gray and muted dusty crimson cloth streaming left. Same opaque skirt, same single black stocking, no underwear. No added FX, blur, floor shadow, background, text or border. One finished full-body transparent sprite.
